rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for both a journalist and a news reporter.

example.english: That journalist is always chasing us for questions.
example.traditional: 嗰個記者成日追住我哋問。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 gei3 ze2 seng4 jat6 zeoi1 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 man6

rows.note: Use this more formal term for someone working in journalism or the news media rather than the everyday reporter term.

example.traditional: 新聞工作者要保持中立。
example.jyutping: san1 man4 gung1 zok3 ze2 jiu3 bou2 ci4 zung1 lap6
